title: Tien_GPT_P3_Weeks1-4_Boostcamp_UPDATED
author: Tien N.
desc: Transform your fitness journey with the Tien_GPT_P3_Weeks1-4_Boostcamp program! Over the course of 4 weeks, you'll engage in a dynamic training regimen designed for 4 days a week, focusing on building strength and endurance. Each session is crafted to challenge your limits while ensuring proper recovery, helping you to maximize your results. Get ready to boost your performance and achieve your goals with a structured approach that keeps you motivated and on track!

Keep. Shoulder stays behind torso; full stretch.
NEW variation. Curl toward opposite pec; no torso swing.
